description_raw:
Purpose Definitions Open Data Policy Principles Governance Central Online Location for Published Data Open Data Report and Review Open Data Policy The purpose of this Open Data Policy (Policy) is to affirm the City of Oklahoma City’s (the City) commitment to open, transparent,
		    and effective government. The City strives to consistently meet the community’s expectations for Open Data in a positive and timely manner
		    in full view of the public. With the advance of information technologies and the increasing ability to more easily share data, the City
		    recognizes that making information accessible and usable by the public can help improve public service delivery and innovation. The City commits to develop and implement practices that will allow it to: The development and implementation of this Policy shall be overseen by the Data Governance Board, reporting to the City Manager. This policy
		    shall be reviewed by the Board at least every two years. Minor and administrative changes may be made through a vote of approval by the Data
		    Governance Board. Substantive changes will require approval of the City Council. The requirements of this Policy shall apply to any Department, office, administrative unit, commission, board, advisory committee or other
		    division of the City. The Data Governance Board will work with Departments and, if necessary, the Municipal Counselor’s Office, to: The City shall maintain a publicly available location on the City's website or in another suitable online location where the City’s
		    published data must be available for download. Where possible, a published dataset will be associated with contact information for the
		    appropriate group that manages that dataset and a file layout or data dictionary that provides information about field labels and values. The Data Governance Board will publish an annual Open Data Report. The report will include a summary of progress towards achievement of 
		    the goals of the City’s Open Data Policy and how the City’s Open Data work has furthered or will further the City’s strategic priorities. 
		    During the review and reporting period, the Data Governance Board will review the City’s Open Data Policy and management processes in order 
		    to ensure that the City continues to move towards the achievement of the Policy’s goals.

title: Garage Sale Finder
maintained_by: This application is maintained by the Information Technology Department of the City of Oklahoma City.
suitable_use: This application can be used to search for garage sales within the City of Oklahoma City.
limitations_on_use: This data shown by this application is based on garage sale permits which have been issued to Oklahoma City residents.  It is up to the permit holder to determine which days (if any) they hold the garage sale within the days alloted by their permit.  Residents select the category of items being sold and may not be available.

title: Council Ward Map
maintained_by: This application is maintained by the Information Technology Department of the City of Oklahoma City.
suitable_use: This application can be used to view the council ward boundaries and related information within the City of Oklahoma City.
limitations_on_use: This application may display some minor inaccuracies due to the complexity of the boundary for the City of Oklahoma, polygon boundary alignments with other defining datasets, and differences in geographic projection accuracy. Due to these concerns, the actual geographic boundaries of the data may vary slightly from those displayed.
